name: c4x
description: Capture the Claude Code context window into a local SQLite store, and read it back

no-dependencies: This file exists for `engines` and script aliases. It is NOT a place to add packages.
Every tool here runs on Node built-ins alone, node:sqlite included, which is why installing
this extension pulls nothing and why there is no lockfile to audit. That is a property worth
keeping deliberately rather than losing to the first convenient dependency.
The Python side is requirements.txt, and it covers the dashboard only.
